svg.title: AgentFlow architecture
svg.desc: Next.js uses FastAPI and WorkflowService to enqueue Redis tasks. A Celery worker runs LangGraph with PostgreSQL checkpoints and two human approval gates. Kong is a planned HTTP gateway. FastMCP calls the same service directly. Graph nodes use OpenAI, Docker, Jira and GitHub. Prometheus and Alloy/Loki provide metrics and logs to Grafana.
svg.text: FROM JIRA ISSUE TO REVIEWED PULL REQUEST
AgentFlow · durable, human-governed software engineering automation
Solid mint paths are implemented · dashed amber paths are planned
graph nodes call typed agents + controlled tools
Grafana queries Prometheus and Loki. LangGraph executes inside the Celery worker—it is not a separate service.
